name: Xiao Yang
title: Computer Science Student
bio:
Hey, I'm Xiao, a full-stack engineer. I'm pursuing my MS in Computer Science at Northeastern University's Silicon Valley campus.

I'm a Research Assistant at NEURAI Lab, working on YouDescribeX, a platform that uses AI to write audio descriptions of YouTube videos for blind and low-vision viewers. There I've secured 43 REST endpoints, fixed session conflicts between dev and prod, and debugged the AI pipeline. I also built and run Xompress, a PDF compression service, and experiment with multi-agent systems in LangGraph. I'm open to software engineering internships for Summer 2027.
